header: Field days, fixed desks and paid overtime
lead: Half the office is on site most of the week. Everyone still has their own desk to come back to.
bodytext:
Field days start at the Hollerau yard. The vans are loaded the evening before, and the instruments are checked against the pillar in the car park. The driver decides the order of the jobs, not the office. If a site is flooded, the team comes back and does drawing work instead.

Everyone has their own desk, screen and chair, even people who come in twice a week. We tried shared desks in 2019 and stopped after five months. People stopped leaving their field books out, and the field books showed us what was going on.

Overtime is recorded and paid, or taken as time off. Apprentices go to college on Fridays and do not have to make up the hours.
